name: hud
measures: Scenario 1, HUD in view. Sharp HUD on two layers: (a) flight log cockpit_mask result=19/20/24 (views present, cleaned = 4 x frames, fallback reason != 1, lost restores 0); (b) OFXR hud_capture triples (BMP, no alpha) for PEER tools/live/analyze/smear.py; (c) capture: HUD crop sharpness of the synthetic focus layer against its real neighbours (>= 0.9), HUD position (still: <= 2 px), seam and layer mismatch in the band, alpha equal to the next real frame.
cannotJudge: Legibility at the eye. DCS's HUD steps at 20 Hz against 45 Hz frames in both arms. The HUD locator has only seen a drawn HUD and real pictures WITHOUT one: its thresholds are guesses until a flight with the HUD in view.

verdict.cropsAre: found by the HUD locator (saturated green thin strokes) in the first real submission of each layer; NOT JUDGED when it finds none

sideEffects: recenter VR at FLY+8 s: the key bound to "recenter VR Headset" in Saved Games\DCS\Config\Input\UiLayer\keyboard\Keyboard.diff.lua (DCS has no default key: bind one) is pressed twice with DCS in the foreground (Scroll Lock ends as it was)
at FLY+13 s a picture of DCS's window is tested for HUD symbology: none = the flight ends there with "HUD not in view" (first flight 2026-11-15: tracked headset on its stand = eye under the aircraft)
hud_capture=20 writes BMP triples next to the flight log (moved to the run folder's ofxr-captures)
the capture delays xrEndFrame for 40 submissions at FLY+30 s: pacing numbers of that second are void
neverRun: flown once 2026-11-15 17:17 without recenter (no HUD in view); the recenter, the HUD test and the twin plan have not flown
